title: Apple App Review Guidelines
use: Privacy/minimal selected access, explicit permission for third-party AI sharing, account deletion, system review requests and applicable purchasing rules. Recheck exact scope on submission.

title: Google Play subscriptions policy
use: Clear billing/trial terms and discoverable management/cancellation. Regional exceptions and actual product terms remain relevant.

title: RevenueCat restoring purchases
use: User-triggered restore and account transfer/alias handling; not proof that RevenueCat is already integrated.

title: Google Play subscription lifecycle
use: Cancellation while still entitled, revocation, grace/hold and provider-backed state reconciliation.
